types.name: Node
types.doc: Base of every node: a name in the tree, groups, signals, processing.

properties.name: pause_mode
properties.doc: Whether the node processes while the tree is paused.

types.name: Node3D
types.doc: A node with a 3D transform. Drives a three.c object for rendering.

properties.name: position
properties.doc: Position relative to the parent Node3D.

properties.name: interpolate
properties.doc: Render between the last two fixed ticks.

types.name: Node2D
types.doc: A node with a 2D transform (pixels, y down).

properties.name: position
properties.doc: Position relative to the parent Node2D, pixels.

properties.name: interpolate
properties.doc: Render between the last two fixed ticks.

properties.name: modulate
properties.doc: Tint multiplied into this node and its children.

properties.name: self_modulate
properties.doc: Tint multiplied into this node only.

types.name: Camera3D
types.doc: A perspective camera.

properties.name: current
properties.doc: The first current camera in tree order renders.

types.name: MeshInstance3D
types.doc: Draws a mesh: a built-in primitive or a mesh resource.

properties.name: primitive
properties.doc: Built-in shape when no mesh resource is set.

properties.name: clearcoat
properties.doc: Physical: a clear lacquer layer over the surface (0 = none).

properties.name: clearcoat_roughness
properties.doc: Physical: roughness of the clearcoat layer.

properties.name: sheen
properties.doc: Physical: a soft velvet / fabric / fur sheen (0 = none).

properties.name: iridescence
properties.doc: Physical: thin-film iridescence, soap bubble / beetle shell (0 = none).

properties.name: iridescence_ior
properties.doc: Physical: index of refraction of the iridescent film.

properties.name: ior
properties.doc: Physical: index of refraction (1.5 = glass-like dielectric).

properties.name: specular_intensity
properties.doc: Physical: strength of the dielectric specular reflection.

properties.name: anisotropy
properties.doc: Physical: stretched highlights, brushed metal (0 = none).

properties.name: static
properties.doc: Does not move: joins the visibility BVH (visibility.h).

properties.name: lod_bias
properties.doc: Scales the LOD error budget (2 = coarser sooner).

properties.name: visibility_range
properties.doc: Hidden beyond this camera distance (0 = no limit).

properties.name: occlusion_cull
properties.doc: May be hidden by GPU occlusion queries.

properties.name: impostor
properties.doc: Beyond impostor_distance, draw an octahedral impostor instead of the mesh.

properties.name: impostor_distance
properties.doc: Camera distance where the impostor is fully in.

properties.name: impostor_fade
properties.doc: Distance over which the impostor fades in over the mesh.

properties.name: lod
properties.doc: Level drawn last frame (-1 culled, 100 impostor; needs a VisibilityManager).

properties.name: gi_mode
properties.doc: STATIC: baked geometry (a lightmap of its own; occludes and bounces light in the bake). DYNAMIC: lit by the baked probe grid (cartwheel/lightmap.h).

properties.name: lightmap_scale
properties.doc: Multiplier of LightmapGI.texel_density for this mesh.

types.name: Light3D
types.doc: Base of the light types.

properties.name: shadow_extent
properties.doc: Directional: half size of the square the shadow map covers, metres around the light's position (move the light with the action to keep its shadows sharp); 0 = 5.

properties.name: shadow_far
properties.doc: Directional: shadow camera depth along -Z from the light; 0 = 500.

properties.name: shadow_bias
properties.doc: Depth bias of the shadow test (small negative values cure acne).

properties.name: shadow_normal_bias
properties.doc: Offset along the surface normal for the shadow lookup (metres).

properties.name: range
properties.doc: Omni/spot: distance where light reaches zero (0 = infinite).

properties.name: bake
properties.doc: Contributes to baked lightmaps and ambient probes (LightmapGI).

properties.name: shadow_cascades
properties.doc: Directional: 0 = one shadow map around the light; 1-4 = cascaded shadow maps that follow the camera (r186 CSMShadowNode; shadow_size is each cascade's; cartwheel/lighting.h).

properties.name: shadow_distance
properties.doc: Directional cascades: where the last ends (0 = the camera's far).

types.name: DirectionalLight3D
types.doc: Sun-like light along -Z.

types.name: OmniLight3D
types.doc: Point light.

types.name: SpotLight3D
types.doc: Cone light along -Z.

types.name: WorldEnvironment
types.doc: Background, ambient light and fog for the tree's 3D scene.

properties.name: background
properties.doc: Clear colour behind the scene: a scene-linear HDR value like every lit pixel (exposure and the tone curve apply to it, so fogged objects fade exactly into it).

types.name: PostProcess
types.doc: The render pipeline's settings for this tree (one per tree; the last in tree order wins): HDR, MSAA, exposure, tone curve, bloom, SSAO, TAA, FXAA/SMAA, LUT grading, vignette, grain, chromatic aberration.

properties.name: hdr
properties.doc: Render the scene into RGBA16F (linear HDR; off: RGBA8, banding in the darks, for MSAA in WebGPU compatibility mode).

properties.name: msaa
properties.doc: MSAA samples on the scene pass (0 = off).

properties.name: depth_prepass
properties.doc: Depth-only pass before the scene (early-z for heavy fragment shaders).

properties.name: tonemap
properties.doc: Tone curve (three.js r186's: AGX by default).

properties.name: bloom_intensity
properties.doc: Share of the bright energy spread by bloom.

properties.name: bloom_threshold
properties.doc: Scene-linear brightness where bloom starts (0 = all light).

properties.name: bloom_knee
properties.doc: Soft transition around the threshold, as a fraction of it.

properties.name: bloom_radius
properties.doc: Upsample tent radius in texels of each level.

properties.name: ssao
properties.doc: Ground-truth ambient occlusion (half resolution, depth-aware upsample).

properties.name: ssr
properties.doc: Screen-space reflections (half resolution) of surfaces with the GI shading part (gi.h).

properties.name: ssr_max_distance
properties.doc: How far a screen-space reflection reaches (view units).

properties.name: ssr_thickness
properties.doc: How deep a surface counts as hit behind the depth.

properties.name: ssr_quality
properties.doc: March steps per pixel of the ray's screen length.

properties.name: ssgi
properties.doc: Screen-space bounce light and AO (half resolution) of surfaces with the GI shading part (gi.h).

properties.name: ssgi_thickness
properties.doc: How thick a surface is assumed behind the depth.

properties.name: taa
properties.doc: Temporal antialiasing (camera jitter, reprojection, history clipping).

properties.name: grade
properties.doc: Colour grading with the 3D LUT in `lut`.

properties.name: grade_intensity
properties.doc: Blend between the ungraded and graded image.

properties.name: grain
properties.doc: Film grain (integer hash noise, new every frame).

properties.name: debug_view
properties.doc: Show an intermediate buffer instead of the image (depth, normals, AO, velocity, bloom).

types.name: ProceduralSky
types.doc: A physically based sky (Rayleigh + Mie single scattering) with a day / night cycle: it drives a DirectionalLight3D, is the background and (prefiltered) the scene's environment.

properties.name: day_speed
properties.doc: Hours of the day per second of game time (the day / night cycle; 0 = still).

properties.name: declination
properties.doc: The sun's declination in degrees (the season: +23.44 June solstice, -23.44 December).

properties.name: north
properties.doc: Where north is: degrees clockwise (seen from above) from -Z.

properties.name: sun
properties.doc: Path to the DirectionalLight3D the sky drives (direction, colour, energy).

properties.name: sun_energy
properties.doc: The sun's illuminance before the atmosphere (physical units; the light gets this x transmittance).

properties.name: sky_energy
properties.doc: Sky radiance multiplier (1 = physically scattered sunlight).

properties.name: rayleigh
properties.doc: Air density multiplier (blue sky, red sunsets).

properties.name: mie
properties.doc: Haze density multiplier (glow around the sun, washed-out horizon).

properties.name: sun_size
properties.doc: Apparent diameter of the sun disk, degrees.

properties.name: sun_disk_intensity
properties.doc: Sun disk brightness as a share of the physical radiance (it is extreme: 1 = physical).

properties.name: night_color
properties.doc: Radiance added everywhere (the night sky's floor).

properties.name: background
properties.doc: Draw the sky as the scene's background.

properties.name: environment
properties.doc: Prefilter the sky into the scene's environment (image-based light).

properties.name: env_update_angle
properties.doc: Re-render the sky cube and environment when the sun moved this many degrees.

properties.name: resolution
properties.doc: Sky cube face size in texels.

types.name: HeightFog
types.doc: Exponential height fog in the post chain (from depth): sky-coloured, with a sun lobe.

properties.name: density
properties.doc: Extinction per world unit at base_height.

properties.name: height_falloff
properties.doc: How fast the density falls with height (per unit; 0 = uniform fog).

properties.name: color
properties.doc: In-scattered colour (linear radiance) when there is no sky or use_sky_color is off.

properties.name: use_sky_color
properties.doc: Take the colour from the ProceduralSky's horizon (when there is one).

properties.name: sun_scatter
properties.doc: Share of sunlight the fog scatters toward the camera (the glow around the sun).

properties.name: sun_g
properties.doc: Forward scattering of the sun lobe (Henyey-Greenstein g).

properties.name: max_opacity
properties.doc: Fog never hides more than this.

properties.name: start_distance
properties.doc: No fog closer than this to the camera.

properties.name: sky_distance
properties.doc: Distance the sky is fogged as (0 = the sky is never fogged).

types.name: LightmapGI
types.doc: Baked lighting for its parent's subtree: lightmaps (generated uv2) for STATIC meshes, an SH probe grid for the rest; bakes on the first frame or loads a .cwlm (cartwheel/lightmap.h).

properties.name: texel_density
properties.doc: Lightmap texels per world unit (times each mesh's lightmap_scale).

properties.name: max_size
properties.doc: Largest lightmap side, texels (the density drops for a mesh that would not fit).

properties.name: samples
properties.doc: Hemisphere rays per texel per bounce.

properties.name: seed
properties.doc: Random sequence seed (the same seed and scene give the same bytes).

properties.name: probe_spacing
properties.doc: World units between ambient SH probes (0 = no probe grid).

properties.name: denoise
properties.doc: Edge-aware smoothing radius in texels (0 = the raw Monte Carlo result).

properties.name: data
properties.doc: A .cwlm asset to load (empty or missing: bake on the first frame).

properties.name: bake_twice
properties.doc: Bake a second time and compare the bytes (`reproducible`).

properties.name: hash
properties.doc: The bake's fingerprint (FNV-1a 64 of its bytes).

properties.name: bake_ms
properties.doc: Wall time of the bake (report only).

properties.name: reproducible
properties.doc: With bake_twice: the second bake's bytes equal the first's.

types.name: LightingSettings
types.doc: The tree's lighting mode and clustered-lighting settings (cartwheel/lighting.h); CLUSTERED by default.

properties.name: mode
properties.doc: FORWARD: every light is three.c's (8 of a kind at most). CLUSTERED: shadowless omni and spot lights are binned into clusters, hundreds at a time (r186 ClusteredLighting).

properties.name: max_lights
properties.doc: Clustered lights a frame at most.

properties.name: cluster_spot_lights
properties.doc: Shadowless spot lights are clustered too (beyond r186, which clusters point lights only).

properties.name: cluster_far
properties.doc: Where the last slice ends; 0 = the camera's far.

properties.name: light_cutoff
properties.doc: A clustered light with range 0 ends where intensity / distance^2 falls under this.

properties.name: shadow_atlas
properties.doc: Shadowed omni and spot lights are clustered too, their shadows tiles of one atlas (else three.c draws them).

properties.name: shadow_atlas_size
properties.doc: The shadow atlas, texels a side.

properties.name: shadow_updates_per_frame
properties.doc: Atlas faces redrawn a frame at most (an omni light is 6; 0 = no limit).

properties.name: shadow_cache
properties.doc: A tile is redrawn only when its light or a shadow caster in its range changed.

properties.name: batching
properties.doc: Meshes sharing geometry and material are one instanced draw under clustered lights and cascades (off, the default: one draw a mesh, front to back, as three.c draws any extension material).

types.name: Sprite2D
types.doc: Draws a texture, a region of it or one cell of an atlas grid.

properties.name: centered
properties.doc: The node's origin is the sprite's centre (else its top-left).

properties.name: region
properties.doc: Source rect in texture pixels: x, y, w, h.

types.name: AnimatedSprite2D
types.doc: Plays frame animations from an atlas grid or a rect list.

properties.name: regions
properties.doc: Explicit frame rects "x y w h, ..." (replaces the grid).

properties.name: fps
properties.doc: Frames per second for animations without @fps.

properties.name: frame
properties.doc: Frame index within the current animation.

properties.name: process
properties.doc: FIXED: advance by fixed ticks (deterministic); FRAME: by frame time.

types.name: NinePatch2D
types.doc: A nine-slice panel: corners keep their size.

properties.name: region
properties.doc: Source rect x y w h (w 0 = whole texture).

properties.name: centered
properties.doc: Origin at the centre (else the top-left).

types.name: Line2D
types.doc: A polyline with mitred joins.

properties.name: closed
properties.doc: Join the last point to the first.

types.name: Polygon2D
types.doc: A filled (optionally textured) polygon.

properties.name: polygon
properties.doc: Outline "x y, x y, ..." (simple polygon, any winding).

properties.name: texture
properties.doc: Optional texture; uv = point / texture size.

types.name: Label2D
types.doc: Text in the canvas.

properties.name: font_mode
properties.doc: SDF (any size) or BITMAP (pixel fonts at bake_size multiples).

properties.name: align
properties.doc: Alignment within wrap_width (or the widest line).

properties.name: wrap_width
properties.doc: Wrap at this width (0 = no wrapping).

types.name: Light2D
types.doc: A point light; its canvas is drawn lit.

properties.name: height
properties.doc: Height above the plane for normal maps (0 = range/4).

types.name: LightOccluder2D
types.doc: Casts shadows for Light2Ds with shadow on.

types.name: Camera2D
types.doc: The view of the default canvas (and canvases that follow the viewport).

properties.name: current
properties.doc: The first current Camera2D in tree order is used.

properties.name: anchor_top_left
properties.doc: The camera's position is the view's top-left (else its centre).

properties.name: limit_left
properties.doc: The view never shows world x below this.

types.name: CanvasLayer
types.doc: A separate canvas drawn in `layer` order (HUDs, backgrounds).

properties.name: layer
properties.doc: Draw order; the default canvas is 0.

properties.name: follow_viewport
properties.doc: Use the Camera2D (else screen space: HUDs).

properties.name: y_sort
properties.doc: Within equal z, lower y draws first.

types.name: ParallaxLayer
types.doc: Its children scroll at motion_scale of the camera.

types.name: CanvasSettings
types.doc: Virtual resolution, scaling, clear colour and 2D ambient light.

properties.name: scale_mode
properties.doc: How the virtual canvas maps to the window.

properties.name: ambient
properties.doc: Light on lit canvases where no Light2D reaches.

properties.name: pixel_snap
properties.doc: Snap vertices to whole canvas pixels.

types.name: TileMap2D
types.doc: A chunked tile grid with layers and animated tiles.

properties.name: cell_size
properties.doc: World size of a cell (0 = tile_size).

properties.name: layers
properties.doc: Map layers drawn, 1..8 (layer k at z + k).

types.name: Control
types.doc: Base UI node: a rect from anchors + offsets (or from its container), theme, focus, input.

properties.name: anchor_left
properties.doc: Left edge anchor, 0..1 of the parent's width.

properties.name: anchor_top
properties.doc: Top edge anchor, 0..1 of the parent's height.

properties.name: offset_left
properties.doc: Left edge offset from its anchor, UI units.

properties.name: grow_horizontal
properties.doc: Which way the rect grows when smaller than the minimum size.

properties.name: grow_vertical
properties.doc: Which way the rect grows vertically.

properties.name: size_flags_horizontal
properties.doc: Inside a container: 1 FILL, 2 EXPAND, 4 SHRINK_CENTER, 8 SHRINK_END.

properties.name: size_flags_stretch_ratio
properties.doc: Share of the expand space relative to expanding siblings.

properties.name: custom_minimum_size
properties.doc: Minimum size on top of the content's.

properties.name: mouse_filter
properties.doc: STOP handles and stops pointer events, PASS bubbles them, IGNORE is click-through.

properties.name: focus_mode
properties.doc: NONE, CLICK (pointer only) or ALL (pointer, Tab, gamepad).

properties.name: tooltip_text
properties.doc: Shown after the pointer rests on the control.

properties.name: visible
properties.doc: Hidden controls hide their children and take no space in containers.

properties.name: clip_contents
properties.doc: Clip drawing and hit tests of children to the rect.

properties.name: modulate
properties.doc: Colour multiplier for this control and its children.

properties.name: self_modulate
properties.doc: Colour multiplier for this control only.

properties.name: theme
properties.doc: Theme file (asset path) for this subtree.

properties.name: auto_translate
properties.doc: Shown text goes through the translation catalogs (text that is a key shows its translation).

properties.name: layout_direction
properties.doc: INHERITED (the parent's; the locale's at the top), LOCALE, LTR or RTL: RTL mirrors children.

properties.name: accessibility_name
properties.doc: What assistive technology announces ('' = the control's text). Translated like text.

properties.name: accessibility_description
properties.doc: Longer help for assistive technology ('' = the tooltip).

types.name: Container
types.doc: Base for controls that place their children (anchors are ignored).

types.name: BoxContainer
types.doc: Children in a row or column with theme separation.

properties.name: alignment
properties.doc: Where children sit when none expands.

types.name: HBoxContainer
types.doc: Children left to right.

types.name: VBoxContainer
types.doc: Children top to bottom.

types.name: GridContainer
types.doc: Children in a grid of `columns`; a column/row expands when a child in it does.

types.name: MarginContainer
types.doc: Children inset by theme constants margin_left/top/right/bottom.

types.name: CenterContainer
types.doc: Children at their minimum size, centred.

properties.name: use_top_left
properties.doc: Centre children on the top-left corner.

types.name: Panel
types.doc: Draws the theme's panel style; children by anchors.

types.name: PanelContainer
types.doc: Draws the panel style; children fit inside its content margins.

types.name: SplitContainer
types.doc: Two children with a draggable separator.

properties.name: split_offset
properties.doc: Separator offset from its natural spot, UI units.

properties.name: collapsed
properties.doc: No separator; the first child keeps its natural size.

types.name: HSplitContainer
types.doc: Side by side, vertical separator.

types.name: VSplitContainer
types.doc: Stacked, horizontal separator.

types.name: TabContainer
types.doc: One page per child, chosen by tabs.

properties.name: tab_titles
properties.doc: Tab titles, one per line (empty = child name).

properties.name: drag_to_rearrange
properties.doc: Dragging a tab starts a UI drag of kind "tab" (payload = tab index, text = title); drop targets decide where it goes.

types.name: FlowContainer
types.doc: Children wrap into lines.

types.name: HFlowContainer
types.doc: Rows that wrap at the width.

types.name: VFlowContainer
types.doc: Columns that wrap at the height.

types.name: AspectRatioContainer
types.doc: Children keep a width/height ratio.

types.name: ScrollContainer
types.doc: Scrolls one content child.

types.name: Label
types.doc: Text; wraps, aligns, clips or ellipsizes.

properties.name: autowrap
properties.doc: Wrap at the width; minimum width becomes 0.

properties.name: clip_text
properties.doc: Clip to the rect; minimum width becomes 0.

properties.name: ellipsis
properties.doc: Cut with an ellipsis to the width.

types.name: RichTextLabel
types.doc: Wrapped text with a small BBCode subset.

types.name: Button
types.doc: A push or toggle button.

properties.name: disabled
properties.doc: Ignores input and draws the disabled style.

properties.name: button_group
properties.doc: Toggle buttons with the same group name are exclusive.

properties.name: flat
properties.doc: No background until hovered or pressed.

types.name: CheckBox
types.doc: A toggle drawn as a check box.

types.name: CheckButton
types.doc: A toggle drawn as a switch.

types.name: OptionButton
types.doc: A button that opens a list of choices.

properties.name: selected
properties.doc: Index of the chosen item (-1 none).

types.name: Range
types.doc: A value in [min, max] with a step.

properties.name: step
properties.doc: Values snap to min + k*step (0 = continuous).

types.name: Slider
types.doc: Base of HSlider/VSlider.

types.name: HSlider
types.doc: Horizontal slider.

types.name: VSlider
types.doc: Vertical slider.

types.name: SpinBox
types.doc: A number field with step arrows; type to edit.

types.name: ProgressBar
types.doc: Shows how far value is between min and max.

types.name: LineEdit
types.doc: Single-line text input.

properties.name: secret
properties.doc: Draw secret_character instead of the text.

properties.name: secret_character
properties.doc: Drawn per character in secret mode (default a bullet).

types.name: TextEdit
types.doc: Multi-line text editor (the editor's code view).

properties.name: highlight_current_line
properties.doc: Tint the caret's line while focused.

properties.name: syntax_highlighting
properties.doc: Built-in highlighter: NONE or C (cw_text_edit_set_highlighter overrides).

types.name: ItemList
types.doc: A scrolling list of selectable items.

types.name: Tree
types.doc: Hierarchical rows with columns.

properties.name: hide_root
properties.doc: Do not show the root item.

properties.name: column_titles_visible
properties.doc: Show the title row even without titles.

properties.name: select_mode
properties.doc: 0 single selection, 1 multiple (ctrl+click toggles, shift+click extends; multi_selected reports each change).

properties.name: drag_items
properties.doc: Dragging a row starts a UI drag of kind "tree_item" (payload = the item's metadata, text = its first column).

properties.name: items
properties.doc: Indented item text: two spaces per level, '|' between columns.

types.name: Popup
types.doc: Base of controls shown above everything (menus, dialogs).

types.name: PopupPanel
types.doc: A popup that draws a panel and fits its children inside it (cw_popup_show).

types.name: PopupMenu
types.doc: A menu of items, checks, separators and submenus.

properties.name: title
properties.doc: Title in a MenuBar (default: the node name).

properties.name: items
properties.doc: One item per line: 'Label|id', '-' separator, '[x]'/'[ ]' check prefix, '!' disabled, 'Label>ChildMenu' submenu.

types.name: MenuBar
types.doc: A row of menu titles; each child PopupMenu is a menu.

types.name: AcceptDialog
types.doc: A modal message with an OK button; children become its content.

types.name: ConfirmationDialog
types.doc: An AcceptDialog with OK and Cancel.

types.name: ColorPicker
types.doc: HSV square, hue and alpha strips, swatch and hex.

types.name: TextureRect
types.doc: Draws an image.

properties.name: region_rect
properties.doc: Part of the image (x y w h, pixels); w 0 = all.

properties.name: stretch_mode
properties.doc: How the image fills the rect.

properties.name: expand
properties.doc: Minimum size 0 instead of the image size.

properties.name: filter
properties.doc: Texture filtering of `texture` (NEAREST for pixel art).

types.name: NinePatchRect
types.doc: A nine-slice image.

properties.name: region_rect
properties.doc: Part of the image (x y w h, pixels); w 0 = all.

properties.name: filter
properties.doc: Texture filtering of `texture` (NEAREST for pixel art).

types.name: CaptionPanel
types.doc: Shows the active captions and subtitles (cw_captions_*), newest at the bottom.

types.name: RemapButton
types.doc: Shows an action's binding; press it, then press a key or button to rebind.

properties.name: slot
properties.doc: Which of the action's bindings (0 = the first).

properties.name: device
properties.doc: Capture from the keyboard and mouse, or from the gamepad.

types.name: CollisionObject2D
types.doc: Base of 2D bodies and areas: collision layer and mask.

properties.name: collision_layer
properties.doc: The layer its shapes sit on (0..31).

properties.name: body_id
properties.doc: The wrapper body handle (0 outside a tree).

types.name: PhysicsBody2D
types.doc: Base of 2D bodies: surface material.

properties.name: hit_events
properties.doc: Emit body_hit(other, speed px/s) on impacts.

types.name: StaticBody2D
types.doc: A body that does not move by itself (moving the node teleports it).

types.name: KinematicBody2D
types.doc: Follows its node's transform with velocity (pushes, carries).

types.name: RigidBody2D
types.doc: A simulated body; its transform drives the node.

properties.name: density
properties.doc: kg per square meter (mass from shapes).

properties.name: bullet
properties.doc: Continuous collision against other dynamic bodies.

properties.name: freeze
properties.doc: Frozen: a static or kinematic body (freeze_mode).

properties.name: freeze_mode
properties.doc: What a frozen body becomes (KINEMATIC follows the node).

types.name: CharacterBody2D
types.doc: A move-and-slide character (cw_character2d_move_and_slide).

properties.name: velocity
properties.doc: px/s, y down; move_and_slide moves by it and clips it.

properties.name: floor_snap_length
properties.doc: Snap down to a floor within this, pixels.

properties.name: step_height
properties.doc: Step up ledges this high, pixels.

properties.name: push_mass
properties.doc: >0: pushes rigid bodies as this mass.

properties.name: ride_platforms
properties.doc: Carried by the floor body's motion.

properties.name: on_floor
properties.doc: Touching a floor after the last move.

types.name: Area2D
types.doc: A sensor region: enter/exit signals.

types.name: CollisionShape2D
types.doc: A collider of its parent body or area.

types.name: Joint2D
types.doc: Connects two bodies at the joint's position.

properties.name: joint_type
properties.doc: PIN/HINGE (revolute), SLIDER (prismatic), DISTANCE, SPRING, WELD, WHEEL, MOTOR.

properties.name: node_a
properties.doc: Path to body A (relative to the joint; empty = the world).

properties.name: collide_connected
properties.doc: The two bodies collide with each other.

properties.name: break_force
properties.doc: Breaks above this force, N (0 = never).

properties.name: break_torque
properties.doc: Breaks above this torque, N*m (0 = never).

properties.name: stiffness
properties.doc: Spring frequency, Hz (SPRING, WHEEL, soft WELD).

types.name: RayCast2D
types.doc: A ray refreshed after every physics step.

types.name: ShapeCast2D
types.doc: A shape swept after every physics step (target 0 = overlap).

types.name: CollisionObject3D
types.doc: Base of 3D bodies and areas: collision layer and mask.

properties.name: collision_layer
properties.doc: The layer its shapes sit on (0..31).

properties.name: body_id
properties.doc: The wrapper body handle (0 outside a tree).

types.name: PhysicsBody3D
types.doc: Base of 3D bodies: surface material.

types.name: StaticBody3D
types.doc: A body that does not move by itself (moving the node teleports it).

types.name: KinematicBody3D
types.doc: Follows its node's transform with velocity (pushes, carries).

types.name: RigidBody3D
types.doc: A simulated body; its transform drives the node.

properties.name: density
properties.doc: kg per cubic meter (mass from shapes).

properties.name: bullet
properties.doc: Continuous collision against other dynamic bodies.

properties.name: freeze
properties.doc: Frozen: a static or kinematic body (freeze_mode).

properties.name: freeze_mode
properties.doc: What a frozen body becomes (KINEMATIC follows the node).

types.name: CharacterBody3D
types.doc: A move-and-slide character (cw_character3d_move_and_slide).

properties.name: velocity
properties.doc: m/s; move_and_slide moves by it and clips it.

properties.name: floor_snap_length
properties.doc: Snap down to a floor within this, m.

properties.name: step_height
properties.doc: Step up ledges this high, m.

properties.name: push_mass
properties.doc: >0: pushes rigid bodies as this mass.

properties.name: ride_platforms
properties.doc: Carried by the floor body's motion.

properties.name: on_floor
properties.doc: Touching a floor after the last move.

types.name: Area3D
types.doc: A sensor region: enter/exit signals.

types.name: CollisionShape3D
types.doc: A collider of its parent body or area.

properties.name: mesh
properties.doc: CONVEX / TRIMESH: path to a MeshInstance3D or a baked CSG root (relative to this node).

types.name: Joint3D
types.doc: Connects two bodies at the joint's position.

properties.name: joint_type
properties.doc: PIN (ball), HINGE (about z), SLIDER (along x), DISTANCE, SPRING, WELD, CONE.

properties.name: node_a
properties.doc: Path to body A (relative to the joint; empty = the world).

properties.name: collide_connected
properties.doc: The two bodies collide with each other.

properties.name: break_force
properties.doc: Breaks above this force, N (0 = never).

properties.name: break_torque
properties.doc: Breaks above this torque, N*m (0 = never).

types.name: RayCast3D
types.doc: A ray refreshed after every physics step.

types.name: ShapeCast3D
types.doc: A shape swept after every physics step (target 0 = overlap).

types.name: AnimationPlayer
types.doc: Plays animations from its library on properties of the nodes under root_node.

properties.name: root_node
properties.doc: Track paths are relative to this node.

properties.name: autoplay
properties.doc: Played when the player is ready.

properties.name: default_blend
properties.doc: Cross-fade seconds when play() passes blend < 0.

properties.name: current_animation
properties.doc: The playing animation; setting it plays that animation.

properties.name: root_motion_track
properties.doc: Position track whose motion moves root_motion_target.

properties.name: root_motion_target
properties.doc: Node3D (path from the player) moved by root motion.

properties.name: root_motion_lock
properties.doc: Axes given to the target: bit 0 x, 1 y, 2 z.

types.name: AnimationTree
types.doc: Blends a player's animations through a graph: state machines, blend spaces, additive layers.

properties.name: player
properties.doc: AnimationPlayer (path from this node) whose library and root_node it uses.

properties.name: root_motion_track
properties.doc: Position track whose motion moves root_motion_target.

properties.name: root_motion_target
properties.doc: Node3D (path from the tree) moved by root motion.

properties.name: root_motion_lock
properties.doc: Axes given to the target: bit 0 x, 1 y, 2 z.

types.name: SkeletonModifier3D
types.doc: Base of the skeleton modifiers: children of a skinned model's Node3D that adjust its animated pose each tick.

properties.name: influence
properties.doc: Blend of this modifier's result with the pose it was given.

types.name: TwoBoneIK3D
types.doc: Two-bone IK: an arm or leg reaches a target, bending toward a pole.

properties.name: end_bone
properties.doc: End bone (wrist, ankle) placed at the target.

properties.name: target
properties.doc: Node3D (path from this node) the end reaches for.

properties.name: target_position
properties.doc: World target when no target node is set.

properties.name: pole
properties.doc: Node3D the middle joint bends toward (use_pole).

properties.name: pole_position
properties.doc: World pole point when no pole node is set.

properties.name: use_pole
properties.doc: Bend toward the pole; false keeps the animation's bend plane.

properties.name: soften
properties.doc: Reach eases off from this fraction of the chain's length (1 = off).

properties.name: use_target_rotation
properties.doc: End bone takes the target node's rotation (times the offset).

properties.name: target_rotation_offset
properties.doc: Rotation in the target's frame applied to the end bone.

properties.name: reached
properties.doc: The target was within reach last tick.

types.name: LookAtModifier3D
types.doc: Turns a bone toward a target within an angle limit.

properties.name: bone
properties.doc: Bone that turns (head, eye, neck, turret).

properties.name: target
properties.doc: Node3D (path from this node) to look at.

properties.name: target_position
properties.doc: World target when no target node is set.

properties.name: forward_axis
properties.doc: The way the bone faces at rest, in model space.

properties.name: offset
properties.doc: Aim origin offset from the joint at rest, model space (eyes).

properties.name: limit_angle
properties.doc: Most the bone turns from its animated direction (radians, 0 = no limit).

properties.name: in_limit
properties.doc: The target was inside the limit last tick.

types.name: CCDIK3D
types.doc: Cyclic coordinate descent over a chain, as three.js r186's CCDIKSolver.

properties.name: root_bone
properties.doc: Top of the chain (the last link).

properties.name: end_bone
properties.doc: Effector: the bone brought to the target.

properties.name: target
properties.doc: Node3D (path from this node) the effector reaches for.

properties.name: target_position
properties.doc: World target when no target node is set.

properties.name: max_iterations
properties.doc: CCD passes (r186 iteration); stops early when nothing turns.

types.name: FABRIK3D
types.doc: FABRIK over a chain (tails, spines, cables) with cone and hinge limits.

properties.name: end_bone
properties.doc: Chain end brought to the target.

properties.name: target
properties.doc: Node3D (path from this node) the end reaches for.

properties.name: target_position
properties.doc: World target when no target node is set.

properties.name: min_distance
properties.doc: Stop when the end is this close (metres).

types.name: FootPlacement3D
types.doc: Plants feet on the physics ground: raycasts, a lowered pelvis, two-bone legs, feet on the ground normal.

properties.name: legs
properties.doc: "upper,lower,end[,foot]" bone names per leg, legs separated by ';'.

properties.name: pelvis
properties.doc: Bone lowered so the lowest foot reaches its ground.

properties.name: ray_up
properties.doc: Rays start this far above the animated ankle (m): the highest step.

properties.name: max_step_down
properties.doc: Lowest ground a foot reaches below the model's origin (m).

properties.name: foot_height
properties.doc: Ankle height above the sole (m): feet align below it.

properties.name: max_slope
properties.doc: Most a foot tilts onto the ground normal (radians).

properties.name: blend_speed
properties.doc: How fast offsets follow the ground (1/s; 0 = at once).

types.name: GPUParticles3D
types.doc: GPU particles: transform feedback simulation, instanced billboards / meshes, trails (particles.h).

properties.name: emitting
properties.doc: Emitting new particles (turning it on starts a new emission window: alive particles die).

properties.name: amount
properties.doc: Particle count (buffer size); emission rate = amount / lifetime.

properties.name: lifetime
properties.doc: Seconds each particle lives (the spawn cycle length).

properties.name: lifetime_random
properties.doc: Each life is shortened by up to this fraction (hashed per particle).

properties.name: explosiveness
properties.doc: 0 = spawns spread over the lifetime, 1 = all at once.

properties.name: one_shot
properties.doc: Emit one cycle, then turn emitting off.

properties.name: preprocess
properties.doc: Seconds simulated when emission starts (the effect starts mature).

properties.name: seed
properties.doc: Random seed: same seed, same particles on every host.

properties.name: local_coords
properties.doc: Particles live in the emitter's space and follow it (forces too).

properties.name: emission_shape
properties.doc: Where particles spawn (in the emitter's space; MESH: on emission_mesh's surface).

properties.name: emission_mesh
properties.doc: MESH: path (from this node) to a MeshInstance3D whose surface emits (4096 points by area, with normals).

properties.name: emission_normal_speed
properties.doc: Extra start speed along the surface normal (SPHERE_SURFACE, MESH).

properties.name: spread
properties.doc: Cone half angle around direction, degrees.

properties.name: gravity
properties.doc: Acceleration (world space; emitter space with local_coords).

properties.name: turbulence_scale
properties.doc: Noise frequency (noise cells per world unit).

properties.name: collide_depth
properties.doc: Bounce off the scene depth buffer (screen space: only visible surfaces).

properties.name: depth_thickness
properties.doc: Depth collision: how deep behind a visible surface still counts as solid.

properties.name: bounce
properties.doc: Normal velocity kept after a collision.

properties.name: friction
properties.doc: Tangential velocity lost at a collision.

properties.name: draw_mode
properties.doc: BILLBOARD quads, STRETCHED along velocity, or instanced MESH.

properties.name: mesh_primitive
properties.doc: MESH draw mode: BOX, SPHERE, TETRA or NODE (mesh_node's mesh).

properties.name: mesh_node
properties.doc: MESH + NODE: path (from this node) to the MeshInstance3D drawn per particle.

properties.name: size_random
properties.doc: Size shrunk by up to this fraction per particle.

properties.name: stretch
properties.doc: STRETCHED: extra length per unit of speed.

properties.name: color_ramp
properties.doc: Colour over life: "t r g b a, ..." (empty = white).

properties.name: texture
properties.doc: Billboard image (asset path; empty = a soft dot).

properties.name: spin
properties.doc: Rotation speed, rad/s (random direction per particle).

properties.name: blend
properties.doc: ADD (glow), ALPHA (premultiplied, sortable) or OPAQUE (alpha tested, writes depth).

properties.name: soft_distance
properties.doc: Fade over this distance in front of geometry (0 = hard).

properties.name: sort
properties.doc: ALPHA: draw back to front (GPU bitonic sort).

properties.name: trail_length
properties.doc: Trail samples per particle, one per tick (0 = none, max 64).

properties.name: trail_width
properties.doc: Trail width at the particle (tapers to 0).

properties.name: alive
properties.doc: Particles alive now (the CPU's evaluation of the emission function).

properties.name: gpu_stats
properties.doc: Read the GPU's alive count and position sum back every frame (a stall: tests).

properties.name: gpu_alive
properties.doc: gpu_stats: alive particles counted on the GPU.

properties.name: gpu_sum
properties.doc: gpu_stats: sum of alive particle positions.

types.name: ParticleAttractor3D
types.doc: Pulls (or pushes) the tree's GPU particles; up to 8 act at once.

types.name: ParticleCollider3D
types.doc: An analytic shape the tree's GPU particles bounce off; up to 8 act at once.

properties.name: extents
properties.doc: BOX half sizes; PLANE x/z half sizes (0 = infinite).

types.name: GPUParticles2D
types.doc: 2D particles: the GPUParticles3D emission model on the CPU, drawn through render2d.

properties.name: lifetime_random
properties.doc: Lives shortened by up to this fraction.

properties.name: explosiveness
properties.doc: 0 = spread over the lifetime, 1 = all at once.

properties.name: direction
properties.doc: Start direction, degrees clockwise from +x (-90 = up).

properties.name: size_random
properties.doc: Size shrunk by up to this fraction.

properties.name: color_ramp
properties.doc: Colour over life: "t r g b a, ...".

properties.name: texture
properties.doc: Sprite image (asset path; empty = a soft dot).

types.name: Trail3D
types.doc: A ribbon following the node (swords, projectiles); drawn in the particles pass.

properties.name: width
properties.doc: Width at the head (tapers to 0 at the tail).

properties.name: color_ramp
properties.doc: Colour along the trail, t = 0 at the head: "t r g b a, ...".

properties.name: emitting
properties.doc: Recording; off lets the tail shrink away.

types.name: Decal3D
types.doc: A box-projected image on the scene's geometry, or (mode MESH) clipped onto the meshes it lands on (decals.h).

properties.name: size
properties.doc: Box size: x width, y height, z projection depth.

properties.name: texture
properties.doc: Image asset (empty = a soft round splat).

properties.name: region
properties.doc: x y w h in image pixels (0 = the whole image).

properties.name: blend
properties.doc: MIX (over, unlit), MULTIPLY (darkens, lit) or ADD (glow).

properties.name: normal_fade
properties.doc: Fade on surfaces turned away from the projection axis.

properties.name: edge_fade
properties.doc: Fraction of the depth fading out at the box ends.

properties.name: mode
properties.doc: SCREEN (projected on the scene's depth each frame) or MESH (clipped from the target meshes once: lands on characters and transparent surfaces, follows them).

properties.name: target
properties.doc: MESH: node path from the decal to the node to stick to (it and everything under it); empty = every mesh the box overlaps.

properties.name: max_triangles
properties.doc: MESH: the most triangles one decal keeps.

properties.name: mesh_offset
properties.doc: MESH: metres the decal floats off the surface.

properties.name: max_mesh_decals
properties.doc: MESH: above 0 the decal joins the tree's pool, which keeps this many (the newest one's value counts) and frees the oldest past it; 0 = never recycled.

types.name: VisibilityManager
types.doc: Culling (BVH frustum, occlusion queries, portals), LOD and impostors for the tree's meshes (visibility.h).

properties.name: frustum_cull
properties.doc: Frustum culling: a SIMD BVH4 over static meshes, a flat pass over the rest.

properties.name: occlusion_cull
properties.doc: GPU occlusion queries on bounding boxes (one frame of latency, never pops).

properties.name: occlusion_wait
properties.doc: Read every query result at the next frame, waiting if needed (same counts on every host).

properties.name: occlusion_margin
properties.doc: Query boxes grow by this (plus 3 frames of camera motion).

properties.name: occlusion_interval
properties.doc: Visible meshes are re-queried every this many frames (staggered).

properties.name: occlusion_requery_occluded
properties.doc: Occluded meshes are re-queried every this many frames (1: every frame; more saves queries but shows disocclusion late).

properties.name: occlusion_guard
properties.doc: Grow query boxes by the camera's motion and parallax over the latency, and trust no result while the camera brushes an occluder (off: plain one-frame-late queries, which pop).

properties.name: lod
properties.doc: Pick LOD levels by screen-space error.

properties.name: impostors
properties.doc: Draw far meshes with `impostor` set as octahedral impostors.

properties.name: shadow_distance
properties.doc: Shadow casters' boxes are swept this far along the light.

properties.name: visible
properties.doc: Drawn (as a mesh or an impostor).

properties.name: occlusion_culled
properties.doc: Hidden behind what the scene drew.

properties.name: portal_culled
properties.doc: In rooms the camera cannot see into.

properties.name: query_latency
properties.doc: Frames the last query result took.

properties.name: impostor_fading
properties.doc: Impostors fading in over their mesh.

properties.name: cull_ms
properties.doc: CPU milliseconds of the visibility pass.

types.name: Room3D
types.doc: Interior space for portal culling: static meshes centred inside belong to it.

properties.name: extents
properties.doc: Half sizes of the room's box.

types.name: Portal3D
types.doc: An opening between two rooms (or a room and the outside).

properties.name: size
properties.doc: Opening width and height (the node's XY plane).

properties.name: enabled
properties.doc: Open (false: a shut door blocks the view).

types.name: Terrain3D
types.doc: Heightmap terrain: CDLOD, Box3D height-field collision, Terrain3D-style splat (terrain.h).

properties.name: size_x
properties.doc: Quads along x (a multiple of grid_quads).

properties.name: region_size
properties.doc: Quads per physics region (a power of two).

properties.name: min_height
properties.doc: Height of step 0 (metres, above the node).

properties.name: grid_quads
properties.doc: Quads along a patch's side (power of two).

properties.name: lod_count
properties.doc: Levels (0 = as many as the size allows).

properties.name: lod0_range
properties.doc: Metres the finest level reaches (0 = the least that stays crack-free).

properties.name: far_distance
properties.doc: Metres past which only the macro colour is drawn (x quality).

properties.name: visible_range
properties.doc: Patches farther are not drawn (0 = unlimited).

properties.name: heightmap
properties.doc: 16-bit grey PNG or .r16 heightmap (resized to the samples).

properties.name: control
properties.doc: Terrain3D control map as a PNG (RGBA = the word, big end in R).

properties.name: splat
properties.doc: RGBA weights for layers 0..3 (used when control is empty).

properties.name: generate_seed
properties.doc: With no heightmap: fBm heights from this seed (0 = flat).

properties.name: generate_amplitude
properties.doc: Generated heights' share of the range.

properties.name: layer0_albedo
properties.doc: Layer 0: albedo RGB + height A image.

properties.name: layer0_normal
properties.doc: Layer 0: normal RGB (+Y) + roughness A image.

properties.name: layer1_albedo
properties.doc: Layer 1: albedo RGB + height A image.

properties.name: layer1_normal
properties.doc: Layer 1: normal RGB (+Y) + roughness A image.

properties.name: layer2_albedo
properties.doc: Layer 2: albedo RGB + height A image.

properties.name: layer2_normal
properties.doc: Layer 2: normal RGB (+Y) + roughness A image.

properties.name: layer3_albedo
properties.doc: Layer 3: albedo RGB + height A image.

properties.name: layer3_normal
properties.doc: Layer 3: normal RGB (+Y) + roughness A image.

properties.name: layer4_albedo
properties.doc: Layer 4: albedo RGB + height A image.

properties.name: layer4_normal
properties.doc: Layer 4: normal RGB (+Y) + roughness A image.

properties.name: layer5_albedo
properties.doc: Layer 5: albedo RGB + height A image.

properties.name: layer5_normal
properties.doc: Layer 5: normal RGB (+Y) + roughness A image.

properties.name: layer6_albedo
properties.doc: Layer 6: albedo RGB + height A image.

properties.name: layer6_normal
properties.doc: Layer 6: normal RGB (+Y) + roughness A image.

properties.name: layer7_albedo
properties.doc: Layer 7: albedo RGB + height A image.

properties.name: layer7_normal
properties.doc: Layer 7: normal RGB (+Y) + roughness A image.

properties.name: physics
properties.doc: Height-field bodies in the tree's 3D world.

properties.name: cast_shadow
properties.doc: The near patches cast shadows (morphed as drawn).

properties.name: quality
properties.doc: Shading level 0..3 (Low..Ultra); -1 follows the graphics settings.

types.name: TerrainScatter3D
types.doc: A scatter layer (grass, rocks, trees) of its parent Terrain3D (terrain.h).

properties.name: shape
properties.doc: Built-in mesh when `mesh` is empty: GRASS (tufts), ROCK, TREE (two LODs each, vertex coloured).

properties.name: mesh
properties.doc: A glTF mesh: "file.glb#mesh/m/p" one primitive, or "file.glb" (one mesh) its primitives as parts (a trunk and a crown); its LOD chains give the LODs.

properties.name: density
properties.doc: Instances per square metre at full density.

properties.name: density_map
properties.doc: Grey image over the whole terrain scaling the density (empty = 1).

properties.name: layers
properties.doc: Control layers it grows on (bit i = layer i; 0 = all).

properties.name: min_slope
properties.doc: Steepest ground it grows on, degrees.

properties.name: align
properties.doc: Tilt with the ground (grass, rocks) instead of standing up (trees).

properties.name: sink
properties.doc: Metres pushed into the ground (x scale).

properties.name: fade
properties.doc: Metres at the end of visible_range over which instances shrink away.

properties.name: lod_distance
properties.doc: Metres where each coarser mesh LOD takes over (LOD i + 1 at (i + 1) x this).

properties.name: knob
properties.doc: Which quality density thins it: GRASS or SCATTER (cartwheel/quality.h).

properties.name: seed
properties.doc: Placement seed (mixed with the node's name).

types.name: Cloth3D
types.doc: A rectangle of cloth (cloth.h): flags, banners, capes, curtains. Pinned to this node or attach_to.

properties.name: pin
properties.doc: Which particles hold: the top edge (banner, cape), the left edge (flag on a pole), corners or none.

properties.name: attach_to
properties.doc: Path of the node the pins follow (a body node pulls on the body); empty = this node.

properties.name: bone
properties.doc: A bone (three.c object name) under the attach_to node's model whose transform the pins follow instead.

properties.name: skin_distance
properties.doc: > 0: particles stay within this many metres (at the far edge) of the rest shape riding the pins' frame.

properties.name: stretch_compliance
properties.doc: m/N of the edges (0 = as stiff as the substeps allow).

properties.name: bend_compliance
properties.doc: m/N across neighbouring triangles (< 0 = no bending).

properties.name: tether_slack
properties.doc: Tethers hold particles within rest distance x this of the pins (0 = off).

properties.name: damping
properties.doc: Share of velocity lost per second.

properties.name: collision_mask
properties.doc: Layer bits it collides with (-1 = all, 0 = none).

properties.name: quality_scaled
properties.doc: Cosmetic: Low graphics settings halve the substeps.

properties.name: turbulence
properties.doc: Gusts over the cloth and over time.

properties.name: pattern
properties.doc: Vertex-colour pattern of color and color2.

types.name: Rope3D
types.doc: A rope or chain from this node to `end` (cloth.h): hangs, swings, carries and tows bodies.

properties.name: end
properties.doc: The far end at creation, in the node's space (the near end is the node).

properties.name: length
properties.doc: Rest length, m (0 = the distance to end; longer sags).

properties.name: mode
properties.doc: XPBD: a particle rope; LINKS: a chain of Box3D capsule bodies on spherical joints.

properties.name: start_attach
properties.doc: Path of a node the near end hangs from (a body node feels the pull).

properties.name: end_attach
properties.doc: Path of a node the far end holds (a body node feels the pull).

properties.name: pin_start
properties.doc: Without start_attach: the near end follows this node.

properties.name: pin_end
properties.doc: Without end_attach: the far end follows this node.

properties.name: damping
properties.doc: Share of velocity lost per second (XPBD).

properties.name: collision_mask
properties.doc: Layer bits it collides with (-1 = all, 0 = none).

properties.name: tension
properties.doc: N: the pull on a dynamic body at the far end, last tick (XPBD).

types.name: Trigger
types.doc: A data-driven rule: when `source` emits `signal`, do `action` on `target` (cartwheel/triggers.h).

properties.name: enabled
properties.doc: false = the rule never fires (another trigger may SET it true).

properties.name: source
properties.doc: The node whose signal fires the rule, relative to the trigger (".." = its parent).

properties.name: filter_group
properties.doc: Fire only when the signal's first argument is a node in this group (empty = always).

properties.name: action
properties.doc: What happens: SET a property, CALL a method, EMIT a signal, SPAWN a scene, FREE the target, CHANGE_SCENE.

properties.name: target
properties.doc: The node acted on, relative to the trigger (".." = its parent).

properties.name: member
properties.doc: SET: property; CALL: method; EMIT: signal; SPAWN: the new node's name (optional).

properties.name: value
properties.doc: SET: the value as scene text; CALL: one argument (empty = pass the signal's); SPAWN / CHANGE_SCENE: a scene path.

properties.name: fired
properties.doc: How many times the rule ran (not saved).

types.name: NavigationRegion3D
types.doc: A navmesh baked from the meshes and static colliders under it (or loaded), and its crowd.

properties.name: agent_radius
properties.doc: The navmesh keeps this far from walls, m.

properties.name: tile_size
properties.doc: Voxels per tile side (0 = one tile).

properties.name: dynamic
properties.doc: Build through the tile cache, so NavigationObstacle3D nodes can carve it.

properties.name: source
properties.doc: What bakes: MeshInstance3D meshes, static colliders, or both.

properties.name: navmesh_path
properties.doc: Load this saved navmesh (cw_navmesh_save) instead of baking.

properties.name: bake_on_ready
properties.doc: Bake on the first tick in the tree.

properties.name: paths_per_tick
properties.doc: Agent paths planned per tick (oldest requests first).

properties.name: debug_draw
properties.doc: Draw the navmesh, agents and paths.

properties.name: build_ms
properties.doc: The last bake or obstacle update, ms.

types.name: NavigationAgent3D
types.doc: A crowd agent that walks its parent Node3D along navmesh paths, avoiding other agents.

properties.name: target_position
properties.doc: Where to go (world space); setting it plans a path.

properties.name: height
properties.doc: Height, m (agents on other floors are not neighbours).

properties.name: neighbor_dist
properties.doc: Neighbours within this distance are avoided, m.

properties.name: time_horizon
properties.doc: How far ahead other agents are avoided, s.

properties.name: arrive_dist
properties.doc: The target counts as reached within this distance, m.

properties.name: slowdown_dist
properties.doc: Slows down within this distance of the target, m.

properties.name: avoidance
properties.doc: Avoid other agents (ORCA). Others avoid it either way.

properties.name: drive_parent
properties.doc: Move the parent Node3D every tick. Off: the parent moves by velocity_computed and the agent follows it.

properties.name: region
properties.doc: Path to its NavigationRegion3D (empty = the tree's first).

properties.name: status
properties.doc: IDLE, WAITING (for a path), MOVING, ARRIVED, NO_PATH or VELOCITY.

properties.name: velocity
properties.doc: The velocity it moved with last tick.

types.name: NavigationObstacle3D
types.doc: A shape carved out of a dynamic NavigationRegion3D's navmesh while it is in the tree.

properties.name: shape
properties.doc: CYLINDER (standing on the node's origin) or BOX (centered on it, turned with it about y).

properties.name: region
properties.doc: Path to its NavigationRegion3D (empty = the tree's first).

types.name: ReverbZone3D
types.doc: A place with its own reverb: spatial voices' reverb sends feed it while the listener is inside or near (cartwheel/audio.h, reverb zones).

properties.name: size
properties.doc: Box: full size in world units (the node's rotation and scale are not applied).

properties.name: blend
properties.doc: Units outside the shape over which the zone fades out (0 = a hard edge).

properties.name: priority
properties.doc: Where zones overlap, higher takes its share first (a cave inside a valley).

properties.name: decay
properties.doc: Seconds for the reverb to fall 60 dB (RT60).

properties.name: damping_hz
properties.doc: High frequencies above this die faster (0 = no damping).

properties.name: predelay
properties.doc: Seconds before the reverb starts (a new reverb is made when it changes).

properties.name: room_size
properties.doc: Delay line lengths, 0 small to 1 large (a new reverb is made when it changes).

properties.name: level
properties.doc: How much of the spatial voices' sends the zone takes in.

properties.name: bus
properties.doc: Audio bus the reverb plays into (0 = master).

types.name: ReflectionProbe3D
types.doc: Reflections of the real surroundings inside a box: a live PMREM capture, box projected and blended (gi.h).

properties.name: size
properties.doc: The box the probe affects (world units, axis aligned; the node's scale applies).

properties.name: origin_offset
properties.doc: Where the capture is taken, from the box centre.

properties.name: box_projection
properties.doc: Trace reflections to the box's faces (rooms, corridors) instead of at infinity (outdoors).

properties.name: blend_distance
properties.doc: Distance inside the box over which the probe fades out at its faces.

properties.name: intensity
properties.doc: Multiplier of what the probe reflects.

properties.name: ambient
properties.doc: The probe also gives the diffuse ambient light, in place of the sky's.

properties.name: resolution
properties.doc: Capture face size in pixels (a power of two; the quality preset scales it).

properties.name: update_mode
properties.doc: ONCE (first frame), ON_DEMAND (the update method) or EVERY_N_FRAMES (update_every).

properties.name: update_every
properties.doc: EVERY_N_FRAMES: frames between captures (the quality preset scales it).

properties.name: cull_mask
properties.doc: Layers the capture sees (three.c object layers; -1 = all).

types.name: LightProbeGrid3D
types.doc: Bounce light: a grid of L2 spherical-harmonic probes captured from the scene (three.js r186 LightProbeGrid; gi.h).

properties.name: size
properties.doc: The grid's box (world units, axis aligned; the node's scale applies).

properties.name: probes
properties.doc: Probes along x, y, z (2 .. 32 each; 0 = one a metre plus one, as r186).

properties.name: cube_size
properties.doc: Each probe's capture face size in pixels (r186: 8).

properties.name: bounces
properties.doc: Extra sweeps of the bake, each adding a bounce.

properties.name: update_mode
properties.doc: BAKED (once, at load) or INCREMENTAL (then probes_per_frame probes every frame, for moving lights).

properties.name: probes_per_frame
properties.doc: INCREMENTAL: probes refreshed a frame (the quality preset scales it).

properties.name: bake_per_frame
properties.doc: Probes captured a frame while baking (0 = the whole grid in one frame).

properties.name: normal_offset
properties.doc: Sample offset along the surface normal, in probe spacings (r186: 0.5).

types.name: CSGShape3D
types.doc: Base of the CSG block-out shapes: combines with its CSG parent by `operation`; the topmost one is the root and draws the baked result (cartwheel/csg.h).

properties.name: operation
properties.doc: How this shape combines with what its CSG parent built so far (ignored on the root).

properties.name: color
properties.doc: Surface colour (linear); faces this shape cuts take it.

properties.name: bake_file
properties.doc: Root: the baked mesh asset cwcsg writes (.cwcsg); empty or missing = the preview.

properties.name: roughness
properties.doc: Root: PBR roughness of the whole result.

properties.name: metalness
properties.doc: Root: PBR metalness of the whole result.

properties.name: ghosts
properties.doc: Root, preview: draw subtracted (red) and intersected (blue) shapes see-through.

properties.name: stale
properties.doc: Root: the shapes changed since the bake file was baked.

properties.name: file_hash
properties.doc: Root: FNV-1a 64 of the bake file's bytes (hex).

properties.name: mesh_hash
properties.doc: Root: FNV-1a 64 of the loaded geometry's attributes and indices (hex).

types.name: CSGCombiner3D
types.doc: A CSG node with no shape of its own: groups CSG children (cartwheel/csg.h).

types.name: CSGBox3D
types.doc: A CSG box (cartwheel/csg.h).

properties.name: size
properties.doc: Extents along x, y and z, centred on the node.

types.name: CSGCylinder3D
types.doc: A CSG cylinder or cone along Y (cartwheel/csg.h).

properties.name: radius
properties.doc: Radius (at the bottom for a cone).

properties.name: height
properties.doc: Height along Y, centred on the node.

properties.name: cone
properties.doc: A cone: the top is a point.

types.name: CSGSphere3D
types.doc: A CSG sphere (cartwheel/csg.h).

properties.name: segments
properties.doc: Facets around the equator (the bake rounds up to a multiple of 4).

types.name: NetSynchronizer
types.doc: Replicates properties of root_path from its network authority to every other peer (cartwheel/net.h).

properties.name: root_path
properties.doc: path from this node to the node whose properties replicate

types.name: NetSpawner
types.doc: Replicates creation and removal of spawn_path's children (listed scenes or types) from its authority (cartwheel/net.h).

properties.name: spawn_path
properties.doc: path from this node to the node whose children replicate

properties.name: spawnable
properties.doc: comma-separated scene paths (*.cwscene) or node type names
